facts.fact: The FY2025 finance law (decree 24-186/PR of 19 December 2024) appropriates KMF 9,128,000 (salaries 6,128,000, goods and services 3,000,000) for the Direction Generale de l'informatique, the state's computing directorate in the finance ministry; the FY2026 volume shows the 2025 rectificative cut it to KMF 0.

The directorate's appropriation is KMF 9,128,000 in the 2025 law and the same KMF 9,128,000 in the 2024 rectified column (LFR 2024), so the later year is the same; the FY2025 rectificative then revised 2025 to KMF 0.

note: Budget line record; the FY2025 original and the 2024 comparator are equal, which the study rule files as fell.
